references.text: Describes the actual killing of Abimelech's seventy brothers on one stone in Ophrah.
Summarizes how God repaid Abimelech's wickedness and how Jotham's curse was fulfilled over the men of Shechem.
The principle that God demands blood back from the one who sheds it - the avenging of blood.
Reuben reminds his brothers that guilt for shedding blood will be demanded back - a parallel to retribution for innocent blood.
The Lord brought Joab's bloody deeds back upon his own head - the same principle of retribution.
The Lord saw and exacted retribution for the killing of Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada.
The violence of the wicked returns upon their own heads - a wisdom principle of retribution.
Jesus speaks that all innocent blood shed will come upon this generation - the principle of blood retribution.
